entity.name: pid
entity.description: A unique identifier assigned to each patient in the cohort.

entity.name: encounterId
entity.description: A unique identifier for each hospital encounter.

feature.name: primaryReasonCodes
feature.title: Condition codes (ICD-10)
feature.description: ICD-10 codes for the conditions which are the main reasons of the encounter.

feature.name: encounterRef
feature.title: Encounter reference
feature.description: Reference to the encounter the condition was diagnosed in (Condition.encounter). A feature rather than the encounterId entity, because in a feature set join the population's encounterId (the index encounter) takes the place of the feature group's own encounterId column. Used to count distinct encounters instead of diagnoses.
